subtitle: Lesson 10 · Deploying Compute & Storage

eyebrow: Azure: deny by default, then one path in
code:
az storage account create \
  --name ltvappstorage01 \
  --resource-group rg-prod-eastus \
  --location eastus \
  --sku Standard_LRS \
  --kind StorageV2 \
  --allow-blob-public-access false \
  --default-action Deny

az storage account network-rule add \
  --account-name ltvappstorage01 \
  --resource-group rg-prod-eastus \
  --vnet-name vnet-prod-eastus \
  --subnet snet-app-tier
caption: --default-action Deny blocks everything until network-rule add opens exactly one subnet.

code:
aws s3api create-bucket \
  --bucket ltv-app-prod-data \
  --region us-east-1

aws s3api put-public-access-block \
  --bucket ltv-app-prod-data \
  --public-access-block-configuration \
  BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
caption: All four Block Public Access settings — no ACL or policy can override them later.
